meta.source: Utah 2026 statewide CVR, relational tables (ballots/votes/contests/candidates), 29/29 counties
meta.top_of_ticket: U.S. House (CD) -- no U.S. Senate race and no statewide executive race on the 2026 Utah ballot

definitions.margin: winner votes minus runner-up votes (null for uncontested races, which have no runner-up)
definitions.third_party_votes: votes for Other-bucket candidates (Libertarian, United Utah, Independent American, Constitution, Forward, Green, Unaffiliated, Independent)
definitions.writein_votes: literal write-in votes (no candidate name recorded); kept separate from third-party votes
definitions.spoiler_possible: third-party votes exceed the margin -- an arithmetic screen, NOT a finding that spoiling occurred
definitions.caveat: CVR total is 1,058,810 ballots vs the tracker headline 1,058,813 (Garfield +1, Washington CD3 +2) -- a known 3-ballot feed undercount, not missing ballots.
